rule: materialise one S2 balanced TRAIN artifact per master seed; the S3 model cell with master seed s consumes the S2 artifact created with the same s; no balanced artifact with a hidden fixed seed is reused across model seeds [DEC §1]

s2_plan.cells: 2 tasks x 3 windows x 4 imputer parents (V1, V5, V9, V13) x 3 balancers x 3 seeds
s2_plan.scope: the full P1-P4 TRAIN sequence of the window is balanced once (phase_id=P4); prefixes are never balanced separately

s3_rule.fixed_policy: opt-in only: -AugmentationSeedPolicy fixed -AugmentationSeed <s>; mixing the two flags is rejected
s3_rule.parent_resolution: model_app._latest_balanced_train requires manifest.seed == augmentation_seed, the registered parent imputation run/attempt, the parent-manifest sha256 and the full release identity
s3_rule.run_id_fields: seed, augmentation_seed and parent_augmentation_run_id are part of the hashed run config

role_seeds.seed_sampler = seed_augmentation: the master seed itself (None for pipelines without a balancer)
role_seeds.superseded_plan_v1_6_rule: H(seed, role) = sha256("{seed}:{role}")[:4 bytes]; H(0, "preprocess") = 4072383768; never used by a materialised artifact
